entries.title: Isaiah 35:1
segments: ¶The wilderness and the dry land shall be gladdened; and the desert shall rejoice, and blossom as the rose.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:2
segments: It shall blossom abundantly and rejoice even with joy and shouting: the glory of Lebanon shall be given unto it, the excellency of Carmel and Sharon. They shall see the glory of Jehovah, the excellency of our God.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:3
segments: Strengthen the weak hands and confirm the tottering knees.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:4
segments: Say to them that are of a timid heart, Be strong, fear not; behold your God: vengeance cometh, the recompense of God! He will come himself, and save you.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:5
segments: ¶Then the eyes of the blind shall be opened, and the ears of the deaf be unstopped;

entries.title: Isaiah 35:6
segments: then shall the lame [man] leap as a hart, and the tongue of the dumb sing: for in the wilderness shall waters break out, and torrents in the desert.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:7
segments: And the mirage shall become a pool, and the thirsty land springs of water: in the habitation of wild dogs, where they lay down, shall be grass with reeds and rushes.

entries.title: Isaiah 35:8
segments: And a highway shall be there and a way, and it shall be called, The way of holiness: the unclean shall not pass through it; but it shall be for these. Those that go [this] way--even fools, --shall not err [therein].

entries.title: Isaiah 35:9
segments: No lion shall be there, nor shall ravenous beast go up thereon, nor be found there; but the redeemed shall walk [there].

entries.title: Isaiah 35:10
segments: And the ransomed of Jehovah shall return, and come to Zion with singing; and everlasting joy shall be upon their heads: they shall obtain gladness and joy, and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.
